name: Prime Parity Bipartite Obfuscation
description: Replaced the "difference of calibration integers is exactly 1" property with a new property: there exists an assignment of prime numbers to vertices such that the sum of primes for any adjacent pair is odd. Because the sum of two primes is odd, exactly one must be even (i.e., 2), enforcing a strict bipartition between vertices assigned 2 and vertices assigned odd primes. This forces the model to reason through number theory basics to discover the polynomial-time bipartite structure, defeating surface-level pattern matchers.
